sourceIssues.issue: Source turn07 持ち主かどうか、ご存じの方 is awkwardly framed; intended owner identity inferred from full exchange, not proof of whole-source editorial acceptance.

Source says not claim to have seen places absent from sketch; absence from sketch alone is not evidence about observation. Translation preserves Japanese limitation, source factual framing remains for editorial review.

reviewCriteria: Ueda08: unitless12 means120000yen versus12yen; consultation not actual transaction, readback includes units and decision deferred until explanation.
481: unauthorised flowerbed repairs separate from volunteer joining; missing wheel separate from possession/transport of bag; question submission not meeting attendance.
481: onset date versus form completion; no guessed dates; private key ownership verification and return arrangements; key packaging and shipping pending conditions.
481: 30000 versus300000yen with traceable correction; jam450 each ->3=1350 and2=900; damaged umbrella not proven abandoned; station platform distinct from exit outside gates.

487 Azumino04–08: own viewpoint versus north and rightward car movement; traceable arrow correction; ribbon decoration versus carrying handle; account name versus transaction counterpart with no implied approval.
487: frozen-gift storage and recipient return time require separate confirmation; yellow tactile guideway stays unobstructed before any user arrives.
487 Tajimi01–05: see-off companion returns friend ticket and respects departure; meeting proposal attribution not guessed from moved namecards; doctor silence not diagnostic result.
